title: 1 to 10 Scale Realistic Sable / Create Aeronautisc Air Pressure
description: This datapack changes Sable's default air pressure to instead resemble real world air pressure at a 1 to 10 scale, dropping exponentially less and less over time. (I have a separate datapack which does this at a 1 to 1 ratio instead)
body: Changes **Sable** / **Create: Aeronautics** air pressure to be at a **1 to 10 scale with real world air pressure**, helps keep most balloons both off the ground and also somewhat level with each other. I have also made another datapck which does this same thing but at a 1 to 1 scale with the real world, but I'd use that one with caution when in survival, as you might be soaring for a very long time lol.
